thread:
mira.pm: Quick idea - implement tenant soft-throttle + gradual reshuffle for next regional rollout. Keep high-value tenants protected. thoughts?

sam.k: soft-throttle makes sense. suggest micro-throttle to 10% before full pause.

leila.me: yep. need a short canary metric set: p95, 5m error, eval-drop. add infra-cost-per-1k-tokens.

nate.sre: ops: reshuffle over 10m windows, warmback using KV cache, reserve 10% spare capacity.

mira.pm: policy sketch: slices 0.25% -> 0.75% -> 2.0%, 20m steps. tenant auto-pause after 3 failing windows.

cass.cs: will need per-tenant status in Console and one-click pause for CS. also draft comms template.

sam.k: I'll add per-tenant pause API + RBAC. gate emergency global rollback behind 2FA.

leila.me: A/B labels: A=full model streaming, B=eco-quant no-streaming. will add micro-eval + EWMA smoothing.

nate.sre: checklist: shadow-run 45m, reserve 12% capacity, token-burn cap, alerts for p95/errors/eval-delta.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting micro-canary slice in ap-southeast-1 - runbook RB-2026-022

mira.pm: next steps: finalize YAML, schedule staging dry-run, CS review. I'll write RFC and attach comms + runbook.
